title: Pencil, Brush, Ink Bottle, Paint Bucket, Eraser
description: Pencil tool (Y): freehand strokes with Straighten/Smooth/Ink modes. Brush tool (B): paint fills (solid shapes), brush size/shape, paint modes (Normal/Fills/Behind/Selection/Inside). Ink Bottle (S): apply stroke to shapes. Paint Bucket (K): fill enclosed areas, gap size options. Eraser (E): erase fills/strokes, erase modes, Faucet. See docs/04-toolbox.md.
